claim: Patchline ships role-specific governance documentation so that maintainers, security reviewers, research reviewers, and ecosystem owners each have an explicit, reproducible charter rather than tribal knowledge. The governance worker renders one charter per role from structured data, each with a scope, named responsibilities, an escalation path, and the gates that role is accountable for, and assembles a governance index. The gate proves that all four mandated roles are present and that every charter declares a scope, at least three responsibilities, an escalation path, and at least one accountable gate.
real_repo: patchline (self): governance charters generated from role data

roles.scope: Overall project direction, releases, and merge decisions.
responsibilities: Cut releases and sign release dossiers
Keep the gate suite green on main
roles.escalation: Disputes escalate to a maintainer vote; ties defer to the lead maintainer.

roles.scope: Archive handling, secret redaction, and supply-chain provenance.
roles.escalation: Suspected vulnerabilities go to a private security advisory before disclosure.

roles.scope: Evaluation rigor, claims-to-evidence mapping, and paper artifacts.
responsibilities: Verify claims map to reproducible evidence
Check the limitations ledger stays honest
roles.escalation: Disputed claims are frozen until an independent rerun resolves them.

roles.scope: A single ecosystem's detector, fixtures, and real-repo proofs.
responsibilities: Maintain the ecosystem detector and fixtures
Keep the real-repo proof gate green
Document known gaps in the parser dashboard
roles.escalation: Breaking upstream changes are reported to maintainers with a reproducing gate.
